name: FormAsk
description:
A short form the agent needs filled (a ticket, a schedule): stacked fields, one per row,
capped at the form measure (R15). Values the agent already knows arrive pre-filled.
Required fields validate on blur, then as you type; submitting focuses the first gap.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "form"; fields: FormField[]; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The form ask: the question and its `fields`, one per row, with values the agent knows pre-filled. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
